free_tier.stated: 5 GB of storage space and 5 GB max per transfer, on a free 1-user account.

retention.stated: per-object-cap 5 GB; retention 7 days file availability; pull-count 10 downloads per transfer; 3 recipients per transfer; 5 GB total storage per account.

egress.terms: Free within the plan; download count is the real meter (10 downloads per transfer).

interface_detail: web + desktop app; no S3/WebDAV/SFTP on the free tier
tooling: Filemail desktop app; no rclone backend
chaining: 5 GB storage x unlimited free 1-user accounts = trivially repeatable but each account is a 5 GB silo with 7-day file availability, so aggregate retention is worthless for archive. Would need 100+ accounts to reach 500 GB of *expiring* data.
limits_note: per-object-cap 5 GB; retention 7 days file availability; pull-count 10 downloads per transfer; 3 recipients per transfer; 5 GB total storage per account.
reliability_note: Files disappear after 7 days regardless of account; download cap of 10 makes it unusable for serving.

evidence.proved: 'We provide 5 GB of storage space and the ability to send and receive any file type, up to 5 GB in size', '7-Day File Availability', '10 Downloads Per Transfer', '3 Recipients Per Transfer'
